example.title: McCurdy Smokehouse complex, Lubec (herring smokehouse, c. 1900)

brief: A herring smoking and packing complex on the harbour edge: a row of tall weathered-shingle smokehouses with steep grey roofs standing on timber stilts over the tidal flats, a yellow two-storey clapboard packing building on the street end, walkways between them. Two photos (fog). Older than 1970: herring smokehouses, net sheds and fish houses on stilts in these harbours are 1880-1940 buildings; no newer examples. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
